item.title: Judge grants hearing, expresses concerns ex-Michigan coach Moore may have had rights violated
item.description: A judge on Tuesday granted a request for a hearing to learn more about an investigation that led to charges against former University of Michigan football coach Sherrone Moore, who was arrested soon after he was fired for a relationship with his executive assistant.

item.title: Trump administration backs Kalshi, Polymarket as states move to ban prediction markets
item.description: Any friendly decision the CFTC makes on this industry could financially benefit the president's family.

item.title: Judge blocks deportation of Palestinian activist who led protests at Columbia
item.description: The judge said she terminated the case because of a procedural misstep by government attorneys.

item.title: FBI, St. Paul police probing ICE arrest that resulted in skull fractures
item.description: ICE said he caused the injury when he tried to run while handcuffed and fell.

item.title: Sacramento State men’s football to join FBS Mid-American Conference in July
item.description: The Mid-American Conference will be adding FCS program Sacramento State as a football-only member starting on July 1, the conference announced.

item.title: Focused No. 1 Michigan takes care of business in win over No. 7 Purdue with No. 3 Duke looming
item.description: No. 1 Michigan stuck to the game plan Tuesday night. The Wolverines ignored their ranking, the fact they were playing their first game in 13 years as the nation’s highest-ranked team or the distraction of looking ahead to Saturday’s long-awaited showdown against No. 3 Duke.

item.title: Jeremy Fears Jr. leads No. 15 Michigan State to 82-59 win over UCLA
item.description: Jeremy Fears Jr. had 16 points and 10 assists, leading No. 15 Michigan State to an 82-59 victory over UCLA on Tuesday night.

item.title: Logan Pleasant’s big half helps unbeaten Rochester defeat Adams, wrap league play 10-0
item.description: Rochester Adams will need to wait and work for another chance to put a blemish on its rivals' unbeaten record.

item.title: Utica-Fraser United takes advantage of new life, skates past North Oakland
item.description: Utica-Fraser erupted for four goals in the first 7:54 of Tuesday’s contest and never trailed in recording a 11-3 victory over Oxford-North Oakland United Eagles in a Division 1 pre-regional contest at the Detroit Skate Club.
